description: NaVMoO₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.52 Å. V is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-2.52 Å. Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.35 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one V and two equivalent Mo atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent V and one Mo atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one Mo atom.
